shake hands verb

also handshake

modern

Traupman 107

dextram jungere cum aliquō

Other words

  • dextrās jungere

    also used · classical · M-O s.v. actions: shake hands

  • dextrae jungere dextram — clasp hands, join right hand to right hand

    also used · classical · Verg. A. 1.408: cūr dextrae jungere dextram nōn datur (Lewis & Short s.v. jungō); Traupman 107: shake hands, dextrae jungere dextram

See also hand.

SourcesMorgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. actions: shake hands. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 107.
